idea-plugin.name: Top Status Bar
idea-plugin.description:
A compact, New UI-style status bar rendered as a single custom toolbar component.
Add the "Top Status Bar" action group to the Main Toolbar via Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Menus and Toolbars to show editor, project, VCS and runtime status next to the search icon.

group.description: Compact status bar for the Main Toolbar (New UI)

action.description: The status bar component itself (usually added via the Top Status Bar group)
